definitions.meaning: One who brings a claim or charge

quotations.old_english: Ðone áþ funde ðe se onspeca (claimant) on gehealden wǽre

source_text: on-spreca, an; m. One who brings a claim or charge:--Ðone áþ funde ðe se onspeca (claimant) on gehealden wǽre, L. Ed. 1; Th. i. 158, 20. v. sprecan.
